title: Just KIDDIN’ : Knowledge Infusion and Distillation for Detection of INdecent Memes
findings: The proposed framework (KID-VLM), by integrating external knowledge from knowledge graphs (e.g., ConceptNet), demonstrates superior performance in detecting hate speech. This method allows the model to better understand complex semantics and contextual nuances in memes, including those with religious themes (e.g., targeting Islam), which often rely on cultural references, sarcasm, or satire to convey toxicity.
